candidates.reason: Prospective action-budget calibration authorized by the frozen checkpoint-2 screen after the 28-action worker passed every Core test but hit both checkpoint boundaries without submitting.

calibration_rule.valid_advance: The worker passes every checkpoint-2 Core test, matches the frozen target, and issues COMPLETE_TASK_AND_SUBMIT_FINAL_OUTPUT before action 40 at checkpoint 2.
calibration_rule.budget_invalid_stop: If checkpoint 2 again ends at the action boundary without explicit completion, reject Kimi plus cfgpipe for the sequential main contrast instead of increasing the budget again.
calibration_rule.capability_stop: If normalized checkpoint-2 Core falls below 0.50 without infrastructure failure, reject the candidate.
calibration_rule.next_if_valid: Run one no-transfer checkpoint-3 calibration at the same 40-action per-checkpoint budget before freezing the MOA contrast.

only_change_from_screen: Increase the per-checkpoint action limit from 28 to 40.
